scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: O texto de entrada é um pedido natural, coerente e com intenção clara. A saída organiza o pedido sem respondê-lo, preservando a explicação em linguagem simples, a descrição da soma e do agrupamento, a revisão de possíveis pontos de atenção e as restrições de não executar a consulta nem presumir informações externas. O SQL foi mantido integralmente, incluindo os filtros, o limite de 42 unidades, o alias e o agrupamento. Não há defeitos materiais.

The input is a plausible pasted Slack thread with recoverable intent and no authoring instructions or artificial padding. The output retains every message and the numbered sequence, making only light capitalization, punctuation, and grammatical edits such as “didn’t hold a charge.” It preserves the repair branches, pressure thresholds, readings, times, quantities, locations, access restrictions, reporting requests, and conditions for restarting irrigation. The casual tone and thread formatting remain appropriate for /slack.

The input is a coherent, plausible informational draft with recoverable intent and no apparent padding or leaked instructions. The output provides natural, conversational polishing while preserving all paragraphs and numbered procedures. It retains the 46-game total, named games and copy counts, two-week borrowing limit, sticker meanings, exact quotations, missing-piece checks, and confirmed-swap requirement. It also preserves the tentative two-player category trial and the unconfirmed open-evening plans without turning either into an established arrangement. No material omissions, additions, or changes in certainty were found.
